# HDFC Bank Ltd (HDFCBANK) – Investment Note

## RECOMMENDATION SUMMARY

Maintain **HOLD** on HDFC Bank at ₹1,738 with a target price of ₹1,895, implying 9.0% upside. Limited near-term appreciation potential given premium valuation and post-merger integration headwinds, though long-term franchise quality remains intact.

## INVESTMENT CASE

• **Strong earnings trajectory**: Company has delivered robust 21.0% profit CAGR over the past five years, demonstrating superior execution despite sector headwinds. Historical median sales growth of 16.4% over 10 years reflects consistent market share gains in retail lending and liability franchise.

• **Best-in-class franchise**: HDFC Bank maintains sector-leading asset quality, operational efficiency, and deposit franchise. The merger with HDFC Ltd has created India's largest private sector bank by assets, enhancing cross-selling opportunities and corporate banking capabilities.

• **Shareholder-friendly capital allocation**: Healthy dividend payout ratio of 23.3% provides income visibility while maintaining adequate capital for growth. Management has historically balanced growth investments with consistent shareholder returns.

• **Digital transformation momentum**: Recent investor presentations highlight continued investment in technology infrastructure and digital banking capabilities, positioning the bank to capture younger demographics and reduce cost-to-income ratios over time.

## KEY RISKS

• **Valuation premium unsustainable**: Stock trades at 2.50x book value, near historical peaks and well above sector averages. Any disappointment in asset quality, margin compression, or growth deceleration could trigger multiple contraction.

• **Post-merger integration challenges**: Elevated contingent liabilities of ₹27.8 lakh crore (likely guarantees and derivative exposures) and low interest coverage ratio flag integration complexities. Deposit mix normalization and margin stabilization remain works in progress.

• **Other income dependency**: Earnings include ₹1.5 lakh crore in other income, raising sustainability questions. Fee income growth may face regulatory scrutiny, while treasury gains are inherently volatile and non-recurring.

## VALUATION

Our ₹1,895 target reflects 2.6x FY2026E book value, applying a modest premium to the stock's current 2.5x P/B multiple. Valuation methodology incorporates Gordon Growth Model assumptions with 13-15% sustainable ROE and mid-teens earnings growth. While the premium multiple is justified by superior fundamentals and franchise quality, we see limited re-rating catalyst near-term given slower loan growth post-merger and competitive intensity in deposits. Fair value remains range-bound until management demonstrates sustained 18%+ loan growth with stable NIMs above 3.4%.

**Conclusion**: High-quality franchise at full valuation. Await better entry point or evidence of accelerating post-merger synergies before upgrading to BUY.
